args: const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),{pathToFileURL}=require('node:url');const home=process.env.CODEX_HOME||((process.env.HOME||process.env.USERPROFILE)&&path.join(process.env.HOME||process.env.USERPROFILE,'.codex'));if(!home)throw new Error('CODEX_HOME, HOME, or USERPROFILE is required');const root=path.join(home,'plugins','cache');const candidates=[];for(const market of fs.readdirSync(root,{withFileTypes:true})){if(!market.isDirectory())continue;const plugin=path.join(root,market.name,'agnets-workflow');if(!fs.existsSync(plugin))continue;for(const version of fs.readdirSync(plugin,{withFileTypes:true})){if(version.isDirectory()){const script=path.join(plugin,version.name,'scripts','workflow_controller_mcp.mjs');if(fs.existsSync(script))candidates.push(script)}}}const script=candidates.sort().at(-1);if(!script)throw new Error('agnets-workflow plugin cache was not found');import(pathToFileURL(script).href).then(({main})=>main()).catch(error=>{console.error(error.stack||error);process.exitCode=1})
